fullPlayAttempt1.failure: ConsecutiveAttackMotionRestartsWithoutRestartingTimingEveryFrame: expected abs(localPosition.x) <0.01, actual 0.048052039. The unchanged test read the transform after WaitForSeconds without waiting for the current LateUpdate. A stale-frame observation is plausible, but the historical root cause is not established because the failing run did not record frame timing or the motion start time. The original failed JSON and raw XML are preserved; product motion has not changed.

sourceFindings: CharacterMotion writes the observed transform in LateUpdate. WaitForSeconds alone does not guarantee that the resumed frame has completed LateUpdate.
CharacterIdlePresentation changes shader property blocks, not transform position, and is disabled during attack and timing spin. Product CharacterMotion and idle presentation were not modified.
changes: Use captureDeltaTime=1/60 and timeScale=1 inside this test; restore both previous values in finally.
Observe transforms after WaitForEndOfFrame while preserving the original abs(x)<0.01 planted-position and abs(x)>0.03 repeated-lunge thresholds.
Verify that the first attack clock stays stable, selecting the same attack restarts its clock, and the repeated attack performs a new lunge.
Verify ten timing-spin updates retain their start time and planted X position, with idle deformation disabled during attacks and spin.
ClearTiming must restore AnimationKind.Idle, planted X position, and the idle shader activation flag.
Failure diagnostics include frame, current time, start time, elapsed time, delta time, action, presenting flag, and X position.
